name: Google Fact Check Tools API
tagline: Search published fact checks by text or image; manage ClaimReview markup pages.
description: Google’s Fact Check Tools API (factchecktools.googleapis.com, v1alpha1) exposes the same claim index as Fact Check Explorer plus a publisher CRUD surface for ClaimReview markup. claims.search and claims.imageSearch return structured reviews (rating, publisher, URL, dates). pages.* create/update/list/delete markup for Search Console–authorized sites. Claim search uses an API key; page management needs OAuth and site access.

auth.details: Claim search (claims.search / claims.imageSearch): Google Cloud API key as query param key= (required; enable Fact Check Tools API in a GCP project). ClaimReview pages (pages.*): OAuth 2.0 scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/factchecktools plus Search Console restricted/full user on the site.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No official per-call pricing page or free-quota numbers published; API key use appears unmetered by SKU—subject to project quotas in Google Cloud Console.

use_cases: search fact-check articles matching a claim or keyword
find fact checks for an image URL (visual misinformation)
filter recent reviews by publisher site or language
monitor new fact checks for a recurring query over time
create or update ClaimReview markup for a publisher’s article URL
list ClaimReview pages registered for an organization
